method: Firefox ESR visible X11 via geckodriver/BiDi; anonymous requests on the ten development domains.
assertions: cache headers observed on three sequential anonymous requests per domain (HIT/MISS or explicit uncacheable private/no-cache)
keyboard-only Tab traversal reaches focusable elements with :focus-visible, computed outline/box-shadow and inside-viewport bounds
page zoom emulated at 200% via layout.css.devPixelsPerPx=2 keeps one institution bar, one main and one H1 with zero horizontal overflow
limitations: Home routes are private/no-cache, so cache-hit is observable as MISS/UNCACHEABLE, not HIT
